title: Kingdom Death: Monster
subtitle: A harrowing boutique nightmare horror campaign of survival and civilization building
tagline: In the darkness beneath the lantern hoard, survival is fleeting
loreSummary: You awaken with no memory upon a barren plain of carved stone faces. Clinging to the faint glow of scattered lanterns, you must hunt monstrous quarries, craft gear from their corpses, and build a fragile settlement to preserve humanity.
keyFeatures: Three-phase cycle: Hunt, Showdown, and Settlement management
Dynamic settlement development with innovations, gear crafting, and principles
Brutal hit location and severe injury tables with permanent consequences
Emergent storytelling driven by population genetics and survivor lineage

kdm_standard.name: People of the Lantern (Core Campaign)
kdm_standard.description: The complete 30 Lantern Year campaign arc culminating in the ultimate confrontation against the Gold Smoke Knight.

kdm_watcher.name: The Watcher Reckoning (Classic Arc)

kdm_extended.name: Extended Settlement Chronicle
kdm_extended.description: An exhaustive 35 Lantern Year saga incorporating legendary quarry hunts, high-tier nemesis showdowns, and maxed innovations.
